title: Finishline Performance Karting
specs: High performance go karts with sessions generally lasting 10 minutes
Multiple kart types for different ages and heights including mini karts for young children
Junior Karts: minimum age 8 years, minimum height 48 inches
Adult Karts: minimum age 14 years, minimum height 60 inches
Dual Kart driver must be 60 inches tall and 18 years old; passenger minimum height 48 inches
Maximum weight for adult karts around 350 lbs, max height around 7 feet
All participants must wear securely fastened shoes; open toe shoes not allowed
All participants must complete a liability waiver; minors require a Minor Release Waiver if unaccompanied

services.desc: Finally, a place where you can be the boss, Finishline Performance Karting is proud to offer an upscale facility where coworkers can enjoy a true team building experience. Our professionally-ran race programs set up lively competitions, including practice runs, qualifying rounds and an award for top finisher. Thrilling, high speed racing is just what you need to keep the bond with your colleagues strong. Trade in those golf gloves for a racing helmet and plan a corporate event at Finishline Performance Karting. Ask about our catering options when

blurb: Guests race high performance go karts on a track with sessions generally lasting 10 minutes. There are karts for different ages and heights, including mini karts for ages 4-7. The facility also offers birthday parties and corporate team building events with organized race programs and awards.
extraNote: Admission is free for spectators; kart rides, merchandise, arcade, and food cost extra · Ride packages cannot be split between customers · 10% military and first responder discount available · Reservations not required; walk-ins welcome; groups of 8+ recommended to reserve · $100 non-refundable deposit required for birthday party bookings
